**17 call sites still pass the flag**, spread over 7 files.

`src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5.

| File | Two-arg calls |
| --- | --- |
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 |

Every one passes a literal `true`, so none of them read the flag from a variable. `ledger.js`, `dashboard.js`, and `refunds.js` are already clean.
